versions.changelog:
feishu-reading-task 1.0.0

- Initial release for automatic creation of Feishu "to-read" tasks.
- Supports trigger phrases such as "加到待阅读任务", "加入待读", "mark as reading", etc.
- Automatically extracts conversation members and relevant content (links, documents) from the chat.
- Creates Feishu tasks assigned to the user and records them in a memory file.
- Integrates with Feishu task creation API.
